title: To-Do List CLI
description:
```
> add Buy milk
> add Finish C++ project
> list
 1. [ ] Buy milk
 2. [ ] Finish C++ project
> done 1
> list
 1. [x] Buy milk
 2. [ ] Finish C++ project
> remove 1
> clear-done / sort / quit
```
hints: The user counts from 1, the vector from 0: check `n >= 1 && n <= tasks.size()`, then use `tasks[n - 1]`.
`tasks.erase(tasks.begin() + (n - 1));` removes one task. `std::erase_if(tasks, [](const Task& t) { return t.done; });` removes every finished one.
requirements: `struct Task { std::string text; bool done; };` in a vector
Parse commands: read the first word, then `getline` the rest
